description: This file defines functions for calculating nutritional summaries based on food entries, including aggregation for specific dates and historical summaries. It imports data models and handles list processing and date-based filtering.

methods.name: NutritionSummary calculate_nutrition_summary(entries: List[FoodEntry], for_date: date)
methods.description: Calculates total nutrition metrics (calories, protein, carbs, fat) for a list of FoodEntry objects on a specific date.

methods.name: List[NutritionSummary] calculate_nutrition_history(entries: List[FoodEntry])
methods.description: Produces a list of NutritionSummary objects aggregating food entries by date for historical charting.
